passage.title: Teacher-written model response for TGA
paras: The light had not failed in forty years. Tonight, the sea hurled itself at the rocks as if it meant to tear the tower down, and the wind screamed through every crack. Inside, the keeper climbed: ninety-nine steps, one hand on the cold iron rail, the beam above him turning, turning, steady as a heartbeat.

keywords.def: ideas, structure and how well the writing fits its purpose
a list of your common mistakes and their fixes

questions.q: Add your three most common errors to your error log with a fix
Core: redraft one paragraph of your Section C answer using your feedback and the model
Extend: proofread the whole piece and fix every error from your error log
Stretch: rewrite your ending so it echoes your opening
Which redraft best improves 'The sea was very rough and scary.'?
options: The sea was very, very rough.
The sea was rough and scary and big.
The sea hurled itself at the rocks.
questions.a: C) The sea hurled itself at the rocks.. A precise verb (hurled) and personification replace vague adjectives.
